name: Mass Attraction
source:
You take the role of Commander Joe Shepherd in his spaceship, the NomanLand! The girls are acting strange and you must find what is happening before its too late!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/reddy]Patreon account[/url]]
translation:
你將扮演太空船NomanLand上的Joe Shepherd指揮官。女孩們的行為十分古怪，你必須在一切還來得及時查明發生了什麼！

（來源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/reddy]Patreon[/url]）
